items.title: Restore missing save-thumbnail BMP sidecars
items.verify: Read the handoff summary and retained evidence first. Any future fix requires a human NEW manual save with a matching readable 640x360 BMP and visible menu preview, with existing saves preserved. The retired live-CDB workflow must not be run.
items.evidence: docs/fixes/save-previews.md#confirmed-in-game-2026-10-28-2056 - save trace showed the in-memory capture finishing ~25 ms after the save checked it (race); [saves] fix_thumbnails writes it late. Owner confirmed ManualSave_0011 shows its preview.

items.title: Confirm Ctrl+F9 / Ctrl+F10 work in game and do not trigger quick load
items.verify: Launch the game, press Ctrl+F9: OSD shows 'Mesh LOD ...' and no save is loaded. Plain F9 still quick-loads.
items.evidence: docs/fixes/quality-audit-2026-10-28.md#in-game-follow-up-1425 — owner confirms Ctrl+F9/F10 work as expected; runtime log records both cycles and enforcement. Plain F9 was not separately reported.
